If damage dealt is Freeze damage or Burn damage, then damage is increased to 10%.

data.effects:
A lively and energetic T-Doll who loves battle. She's simple-minded, prefers straightforward actions, rarely engages in deep thinking, and unconditionally trusts her teammates, obeying all your orders.
"Commander, what do we do next? Haven't decided? Well… how about we go have some fun—"

The maximum stack of [effect:d1d7edac-72f5-4f6b-9727-b4e2ca17324b] is increased to 20.

Each active attack grants an additional 1 stack of [effect:d1d7edac-72f5-4f6b-9727-b4e2ca17324b].

Upon reaching 20 stacks of [effect:d1d7edac-72f5-4f6b-9727-b4e2ca17324b], the effects [effect:59907d05-83e4-4322-979f-a59c6211d5bd], [effect:74085d50-1668-4b60-8319-b76facf5e04b], and [effect:e99ba394-c447-4ce6-a0e8-509caff30eda] are enhanced.

  • [effect:59907d05-83e4-4322-979f-a59c6211d5bd]: When using an active attack on an enemy target standing on a phase tile, ignore 20% of the target's defense.

  • [effect:74085d50-1668-4b60-8319-b76facf5e04b]: Freeze damage and Burn damage dealt are increased by 10%.

  • [effect:e99ba394-c447-4ce6-a0e8-509caff30eda]: Damage dealt to enemy targets on phase tiles is increased by 30%.

doll.name: Soppo
doll.effects:
A lively and energetic T-Doll who loves battle. She's simple-minded, prefers straightforward actions, rarely engages in deep thinking, and unconditionally trusts her teammates, obeying all your orders.
"Commander, what do we do next? Haven't decided? Well… how about we go have some fun—"

skillsLevel3.name: Mad Dog Syndrome
skillsLevel3.description:
At the start of battle, Soppo gains [effect:77e4cfb3-2ca7-4330-89b6-995b7fa8ba3d] and consumes 3 points of Confectance Index to gain [effect:abce6753-fe29-4ca3-b487-7453e982b279] for 3 rounds.
[effect:abce6753-fe29-4ca3-b487-7453e982b279] absorbs 65% of initial attack, up to a maximum of 60% max HP.

At the start of battle, if there are 3 or more Burn-attribute ally Dolls in the team, damage dealt by the basic attack [dollSkill:a01c0ef5-5314-4c8a-952c-4961a40af705], the active attack [dollSkill:e2aecfab-abb0-4ede-9394-f9a671a43a96], and active attack [dollSkill:84618e99-f1b8-449d-a918-d01db7c0faa0] against enemy units with Burn debuffs is increased by 100%.
If there are 3 or more Freeze-attribute ally Dolls in the team, damage dealt by the basic attack [dollSkill:a01c0ef5-5314-4c8a-952c-4961a40af705], the active attack [dollSkill:e2aecfab-abb0-4ede-9394-f9a671a43a96], and active attack [dollSkill:84618e99-f1b8-449d-a918-d01db7c0faa0] against enemy units with Freeze debuffs is increased by 100%.
If neither condition is met, Soppo gains 2 stacks of permanent [effect:647547c5-cf84-48af-ad67-e2d1dd5c82ab].

After using an active attack, Soppo gains 1 stack of [effect:d1d7edac-72f5-4f6b-9727-b4e2ca17324b], up to 10 stacks max.

  • Upon reaching 4 stacks of [effect:d1d7edac-72f5-4f6b-9727-b4e2ca17324b], Soppo gains [effect:74085d50-1668-4b60-8319-b76facf5e04b].

  • Upon reaching 6 stacks of [effect:d1d7edac-72f5-4f6b-9727-b4e2ca17324b], Soppo gains [effect:74085d50-1668-4b60-8319-b76facf5e04b].

  • Upon reaching 8 or more stacks of [effect:d1d7edac-72f5-4f6b-9727-b4e2ca17324b], Soppo gains [effect:e99ba394-c447-4ce6-a0e8-509caff30eda].
